identificationModule.officialTitle: A Clinical Study of CD30 Targeted CAR-T in Treating CD30-Expressing Lymphomas

primaryOutcomes.measure: Measure the safety of ICAR30 T cells
primaryOutcomes.description: To assess the adverse events of ICAR30 T cells infusion in patients with Hodgkin's lymphoma and CD30+ anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Measure the anti-tumor effect of ICAR30 T cells
secondaryOutcomes.description: To assess the anti-tumor effect of ICAR30 T cells infusion in patients with Hodgkin's lymphoma and CD30+ anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Measure the survival time of ICAR30 T cells in vivo
secondaryOutcomes.description: To measure the survival time of ICAR30 T cells in vivo, extra blood will be drawn from patients receive ICAR30 T cells infusion in the follow-up time.
